title: decode.rs: identity/7bit/8bit path copies full body unconditionally
description: decode_body_value() line 67: the Identity/SevenBit/EightBit/Binary arms do body_bytes.to_vec() unconditionally, cloning the entire raw body slice into a new Vec<u8> before max_bytes truncation is applied at line 72. For a large binary attachment retrieved with a small max_bytes limit (e.g. a 5 MB inline image with max_bytes=512 for preview), this clones 5 MB to immediately discard 4,999,488 bytes. Fix direction: truncate the slice to min(body_bytes.len(), max_bytes.unwrap_or(usize::MAX)) before calling to_vec(), or handle the truncation inline.
